access_and_competition.implication: Generic tender search, awards, supplier/buyer analytics, renewals, CPV navigation and agent MCP are already offered by a direct competitor. Free monthly bulk is an authorized path for non-live evidence if the actual file can be acquired.

analytical_caveats: Counts are publisher-advertised file row totals, not independently parsed CSV or a national census.
Monthly tender publication and monthly award records are different cohorts; do not divide awards by tender rows to estimate conversion.
Directory and MCP functionality is advertised, not independently tested; customer counts and sales unknown.
Do not infer actual CPV48 supplier demand, time saved, revenue or payment intent from catalog or file counts.
Only use explicitly public CC BY 4.0 monthly files; do not access restricted daily history or bypass guest limits.
